record.dic_text:
05806 `Azuwbah {az-oo-baw'}

與 05805 同; 陰性專有名詞 人名

AV - Azubah 4; 4

阿蘇巴 = "被遺忘的"
1) 迦勒的妻子
2) 示利希的女兒, 猶大王亞撒的妻子, 猶大王約沙法的母親
record.edic_text:
05806 `Azuwbah {az-oo-baw'}

the same as 05805;; n pr f

AV - Azubah 4; 4

Azubah = "forsaken"
1) wife of Caleb, the son of Hezron
2) daughter of Shilhi, wife of king Asa, and mother of king
   Jehoshaphat of Judah
